rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a device that measures temperature.

example.english: This thermometer can measure the water temperature.
example.traditional: 呢部溫度計可以量到水溫。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 wan1 dou6 gai3 ho2 ji5 loeng4 dou3 seoi2 wan1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a thermometer used to measure a person’s body temperature, especially when checking for fever.

example.english: Use the thermometer first to see whether you have a fever.
example.traditional: 你用探熱針探吓先，睇下有冇發燒。
example.jyutping: nei5 jung6 taam3 jit6 zam1 taam3 haa5 sin1 tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 faat3 siu1
